t: This is the Agatha Christie Memorial, at the corner of Cranbourn Street and Great Newport Street, beside St Martin's Cross near Covent Garden. It was made by the sculptor Ben Twiston-Davies. It commemorates Agatha Christie, the author of sixty-six detective novels and fourteen short-story collections, including those featuring Hercule Poirot, Miss Marple, and Tommy and Tuppence. She is widely regarded as one of the greatest writers of all time, especially in the mystery genre.
